title: Using the exercise yard with a dog
passage:
BIRCH QUAY EXERCISE YARD
Notice at the entrance

There are two fenced areas. The stretch yard is for active play. The quiet yard is for dogs that need space from other dogs. Please choose by how your dog behaves around other dogs, not by its size. A calm large dog may use the quiet yard; a lively small dog should use the stretch yard.

The quiet yard is for one household at a time. Turn the sign on the outside gate to IN USE as you enter. If someone is waiting, please finish within fifteen minutes. Do not shorten your visit just because someone passes on the path. People waiting to use the yard should stand by the blue post where you can see them.

Clip on your dog's lead before opening either gate, not once you are on the public path. The quiet yard will be closed on Wednesday morning while its latch is replaced. The stretch yard and the public path will stay open. Please do not use the stretch yard as a temporary quiet yard.
passageZh:
樺木碼頭犬隻活動場
入口公告

場內有兩個圍起來的區域。活動區供狗狗奔跑玩耍；安靜區供需要與其他狗保持距離的狗狗使用。請依照你的狗與其他狗相處時的表現選擇，不是依體型。性情平靜的大型犬可以使用安靜區；活潑的小型犬應使用活動區。

安靜區一次只供一戶人家使用。進場時請將外門上的牌子翻到「使用中」。如果有人等候，請在十五分鐘內結束。不要只因有人經過步道就提早離開。想使用場地的人請站在藍色柱子旁，讓場內的人看得見。

打開任何一道門之前，請先替狗扣好牽繩，不要等到了公共步道才扣。週三上午安靜區關閉以更換門閂。活動區及公共步道照常開放。請勿把活動區當成臨時的安靜區。
